short_summary: First run (manual, by the implementing session rather than the eventual scheduled agent). Found the Best Day Out and Pangea festivals via web search but discarded both -- resale-ticket-dominated coverage with no 3 qualifying non-resale sources found in the time available. Published Oranjezicht City Farm Market (weekly Saturday market, V&A Waterfront -- organiser's own site + Cape Town Etc + Time Out Cape Town) and First Thursdays Cape Town (monthly gallery walk, Bree St/CBD -- organiser's own site + SA-Venues + What's On In Cape Town). Checked both organisers' sites for an explicit free-to-reuse press image first; neither had one, so both use a themed Pexels stock photo instead (credited in image_credit).
